Keep the guide's high view and broad roof shapes; roof/wall edges must follow the guide rather than conventional low isometric. Do not rotate or reframe it. Keep native square canvas margins. All outside the exact parcel is truly transparent; include no checkerboard backdrop. Native transparency, preserve whole ground silhouette and building tops with margin.
